students.text_sl: Zajemi z LiDAR-jem in z videom, obdelava v Pythonu s pomočjo Claude. Najdlje je prišel zajem obokanega hodnika v kleti UL FA: od oblaka točk do modela s plastmi, tlorisa in kontrole mer s trakom.
students.text_en: LiDAR and video captures, processed in Python with help from Claude. The furthest result is the vaulted basement corridor of UL FA: from point cloud to a layered model, a plan and a tape check.

exercises.title_sl: Zajem z LiDAR-jem in tloris
exercises.title_en: LiDAR capture and plan
summary_sl: Dva zajema z LiDAR-jem: dnevna soba v muzejski hiši na prostem (3D Scanner App, 3 min) in hodnik s stopniščem čez dve etaži (Scaniverse, način Area, 1,5 min).
Obdelava v Pythonu s pomočjo Claude: vodoravni rezi od 0,2 do 2,4 m, ravnine sten po metodi RANSAC, tloris 1 : 50 (PDF, DXF), pogledi sten in video od skena do modela.
Prvi zajem: 1.439.030 točk, dolžina prostora 10,94 m, neto površina 59,8 m².

Kaj ni delovalo: zdrs pri zajemu (globina sobe 5,25 m na enem in 6,72 m na drugem koncu, tla ukrivljena za približno 10 cm); drugi oblak je redek, zaprta vrata niso vidna, uvoz v Rhino v milimetrih je model pomanjšal za 1000-krat.
Meritev s trakom ni bilo.
summary_en: Two LiDAR captures: a living room in an open-air museum house (3D Scanner App, 3 min) and a corridor with a stair over two floors (Scaniverse, Area mode, 1.5 min).
Processing in Python with help from Claude: horizontal slices from 0.2 to 2.4 m, RANSAC wall planes, a 1:50 plan (PDF, DXF), wall elevations and a scan-to-model video.
First capture: 1,439,030 points, room length 10.94 m, net area 59.8 m².

What did not work: drift during capture (room depth 5.25 m at one end and 6.72 m at the other, floor curved by about 10 cm); the second cloud is sparse, closed doors are invisible, importing into Rhino in millimetres made the model 1000 times too small.
No tape measurements.

exercises.title_sl: Video v 3D (SfM) na UL FA
exercises.title_en: Video to 3D (SfM) at UL FA
summary_sl: Trije videoposnetki na UL FA: hodnik, stopnišče v klet, klet in kavarna; tretji tudi z LiDAR-jem (3D Scanner App).
Sličice s ffmpeg, rekonstrukcija s COLMAP, gost oblak z optičnim tokom; skripte s pomočjo Claude.
Najboljši rezultat (širokokotni posnetek, izčrpno ujemanje, približno 15 min): 175 od 175 kamer, 40.236 točk redkega in 50.684 točk gostega oblaka.

Kaj ni delovalo: posnetki, poslani prek WhatsAppa, so bili stisnjeni s 4K na 464 × 832; model se je pri enobarvnih vratih razdelil na dva dela; stopnišče je bilo v prvem poskusu podvojeno; merilo je samo začasno (privzeta višina telefona 1,45 m), zato ni DXF.
Surova LiDAR skena kleti s stopniščem in kafeterije UL FA (oddana 15. 11.), na strani kot oblaka točk v pregledovalniku.
summary_en: Three videos at UL FA: corridor, stair to the basement, basement and cafeteria; the third also with LiDAR (3D Scanner App).
Frames with ffmpeg, reconstruction with COLMAP, dense cloud from optical flow; scripts with help from Claude.
Best result (ultra-wide video, exhaustive matching, about 15 min): 175 of 175 cameras, 40,236 sparse and 50,684 dense points.

What did not work: videos sent via WhatsApp were compressed from 4K to 464 × 832; the model split in two at a plain door; the stair appeared twice in the first run; the scale is only provisional (assumed phone height 1.45 m), so no DXF.
Raw LiDAR scans of the UL FA basement with the stair and of the cafeteria (submitted 15 Nov), shown as point clouds in the viewer.

exercises.title_sl: Klet UL FA: od oblaka do modela
exercises.title_en: UL FA basement: from cloud to model
summary_sl: Podatki: zajemi Študenta 02 (iPhone 13 Pro, SiteScape), lastne fotografije meritev s trakom in video sprehoda.
Čiščenje (vokseli 1,5 cm), poravnava (zasuk 131°, ±0,00 je mediana tal), rez na +1,10 m, prereza A-A in B-B, obok kot krožnica s polmerom 1,41 m, stopnice kot 16 enakih nastopnih ploskev.
Zaprt model s plastmi, tloris (DXF, PDF), 3DM, OBJ, STL; kontrola 150.000 točk proti modelu: mediana odstopanja 4,9 cm.
Kaj ni delovalo: velike datoteke PLY se niso naložile, en zajem je nepopoln in je izločen, stopnice se v LiDAR-ju kažejo kot klančina, tla niso ravna (±7 cm), kavarna je pretemna in je izločena.
Surovi zajemi v Mestnem muzeju in Moderni galeriji (17. in 18. 11.), na strani kot oblaki točk v pregledovalniku.
summary_en: Data: captures by Student 02 (iPhone 13 Pro, SiteScape), own tape photos and a walk-through video.
Cleaning (1.5 cm voxels), alignment (131° rotation, ±0.00 at the floor median), slice at +1.10 m, sections A-A and B-B, vault as a circle with a 1.41 m radius, stair as 16 equal treads.
Closed layered model, plan (DXF, PDF), 3DM, OBJ, STL; check of 150,000 points against the model: median deviation 4.9 cm.

What did not work: large PLY files would not load, one capture is incomplete and was excluded, stairs look like a ramp in LiDAR, the floor is not flat (±7 cm), the cafeteria is too dark and was excluded.
Raw captures in the City Museum and the Museum of Modern Art (17 and 18 Nov), shown as point clouds in the viewer.

exercises.title_sl: Mestni muzej: od zajema brez LiDAR-ja do modela in pota iz videa
exercises.title_en: City Museum: from a capture without LiDAR to a model and a path from video
summary_sl: Zajem 17. 11. 2026 skupaj z Lizo, približno 20 minut: preddverje s stekleno ograjo, stopnišče, spodnji hodnik z lokom in niša pod stopnicami; iPhone 17 brez LiDAR-ja (Kamera, Scaniverse, Merjenje), 3 videi in 2 skena.
Mere s trakom in aplikacijo Merjenje, vsaka fotografirana: ograja 3,30 m, lok 2,30 m, niša 1,35 × 1,40 m, stopnica 16 cm, prag 10,1 cm.

Obdelava s Claude po profesorjevem promptu: čiščenje, poravnava skenov (ICP 10 do 2 cm), zaprt posplošen model (18 stopnic 16,4/27,4 cm, rama 4,65 m), tlorisa in prereza 1:50, pot telefona iz videa 1 (COLMAP, merilo iz višine stopnice).

Kaj ni delovalo: brez LiDAR-ja ima oblak le 56 do 93 tisoč točk (točka na približno 6 cm), drift med etažama do 40 cm; odstopanje oblak : model mediana 13,6 cm, pri LiDAR skenu kleti FA 4,9 cm. Splat v Scaniversu ni deloval, posamezne stopnice in mere pod 10 cm v oblaku niso vidne.
summary_en: Captured on 17 Nov 2026 together with Liza in about 20 minutes: the foyer with a glass railing, the stair, the lower corridor with an arch and the niche under the stair; iPhone 17 without LiDAR (Camera, Scaniverse, Measure), 3 videos and 2 scans.
Tape and Measure app dimensions, each photographed: railing 3.30 m, arch 2.30 m, niche 1.35 × 1.40 m, step 16 cm, threshold 10.1 cm.

Processing with Claude following the course prompt: cleaning, scan alignment (ICP 10 to 2 cm), a closed generalised model (18 steps 16.4/27.4 cm, flight 4.65 m), plans and sections 1:50, the phone path from video 1 (COLMAP, scale from the step height).

What did not work: without LiDAR the cloud has only 56 to 93 thousand points (one point per about 6 cm) and up to 40 cm drift between floors; cloud to model deviation median 13.6 cm, against 4.9 cm for the LiDAR scan of the FA basement. The splat in Scaniverse did not work, single steps and dimensions under 10 cm are not visible in the cloud.

summary_sl: Zasebni prostor s stopniščem (ni objavljen), zajem s Polycam.
Rhino 3D Scan ne zajame prostorov (način za predmete) oziroma jih pretvori v NURBS; Polycam deluje.
GLB se v Rhinu odpre neposredno, pretvorba v OBJ pokvari teksture.
Zaradi omejenega števila brezplačnih zajemov ponovitve ni bilo.
summary_en: Private space with a stair (not published), captured with Polycam.
Rhino 3D Scan does not capture rooms (object mode) or converts them to NURBS; Polycam works.
The GLB opens directly in Rhino; converting to OBJ breaks the textures.
No repeat because of the limited number of free captures.

exercises.title_sl: Primerjava petih aplikacij
exercises.title_en: Five apps compared
summary_sl: Isti prostor zajet s Polycam, Scaniverse, KIRI Engine, RealityScan in SiteScape, vsak zajem 3 do 5 min.
Najboljši oblak točk: SiteScape (PLY, E57, datoteke nad 200 MB); najboljša teksturirana mreža: Polycam, nato Scaniverse.

Kaj ni delovalo: obdelava v Scaniverse se je po 2 h prekinila; KIRI Engine preveč posploši (stene navpične, manjka plošča med etažama, vstavi generično pohištvo); RealityScan izgubi večino modela; SiteScape ne zajame stekla.
summary_en: The same space captured with Polycam, Scaniverse, KIRI Engine, RealityScan and SiteScape, 3 to 5 min each.
Best point cloud: SiteScape (PLY, E57, files over 200 MB); best textured mesh: Polycam, then Scaniverse.

What did not work: Scaniverse processing stopped after 2 h; KIRI Engine over-generalises (vertical walls, missing slab between floors, generic furniture inserted); RealityScan loses most of the model; SiteScape misses glass.

Mere preverjene s trakom: model je v merilu 1 : 1, razlike so majhne (številke niso navedene).
Zajem sta ovirala razstava v kleti in fotografiranje.
summary_en: Four SiteScape captures (Ultra density, full range), saved in one project and exported as one file (5.5 GB).
Dimensions checked with a tape: the model is at 1:1, differences are small (no numbers given).
The capture was hindered by an exhibition in the basement and a photo shoot.

exercises.title_sl: Klet in stopnišče: tloris, prerez in model z AI
exercises.title_en: Basement and stair: plan, section and model with AI
summary_sl: Vsi AI agenti so dobili isto navodilo: iz PLY datoteke LiDAR skena stopnišča in kleti izluščiti tloris in prerez ter narediti DWG/DXF; v drugem koraku 3D model, ki ga odpre Rhino.

Tloris in prerez: ChatGPT brezplačna različica je rezultat dala po 5 do 6 minutah, ChatGPT Plus po 45 minutah. Claude brezplačna različica PLY datoteke ni sprejel, prek vtičnika RhinoAiMCP se je povezal z Rhinom in se po 15 minutah sesul, brez rezultata.
3D model: ChatGPT brezplačna različica ni delovala, ChatGPT Plus je model dal po 45 minutah.
Izdelki: tloris kleti in stopnišča, prereza A-A in B-B, kontrola z izvornim skenom, 3D model (Klet_stopnisce_Rhino.3dm).
summary_en: All AI agents got the same prompt: from the PLY file of the LiDAR scan of the stair and basement, extract a plan and a section and make a DWG/DXF; in a second step, a 3D model that opens in Rhino.

Plan and section: ChatGPT free gave a result after 5 to 6 minutes, ChatGPT Plus after 45 minutes. Claude free did not accept the PLY file, connected to Rhino through the RhinoAiMCP plug-in and crashed after 15 minutes, with no result.
3D model: ChatGPT free did not work, ChatGPT Plus delivered a model after 45 minutes.
Outputs: plan of the basement and stair, sections A-A and B-B, check against the source scan, 3D model (Klet_stopnisce_Rhino.3dm).

Generaliziran model notranjosti (OBJ): obok hodnika kot en valj s polmerom 1,98 m (peta +2,10, teme +2,44), stopnišče s 15 stopnicami (1 × 14,2 cm in 14 × 15,7 cm, nastopna širina 27,6 cm).

summary_en: Merged cloud of two LiDAR captures (Scaniverse and SiteScape), 1.37 million points, with furniture removed; the corridor floor is at height 0.
Generalised interior model (OBJ): the corridor vault as one cylinder with a radius of 1.98 m (springing +2.10, crown +2.44), a stair with 15 risers (1 × 14.2 cm and 14 × 15.7 cm, tread 27.6 cm).
Dimensions compared from tape, cloud and model: corridor 21.80 m long and 2.23 m wide, model and cloud differ by at most 1.5 cm (door height).
Plans of the basement and upper level and sections A-A and B-B at 1:50 (PDF and DWG).
Check of the cloud against the model: in the modelled part (89.6% of points) the median deviation is 2.35 cm, 78.6% of points are within 5 cm.
City Museum of Ljubljana, 17 Nov: hand measurements for checking the capture, drawn onto photos (arch, niche, stair), and two measurements with the phone app Measure.

exercises.title_sl: Zajem treh povezanih prostorov
exercises.title_en: Capture of three connected rooms
summary_sl: Kopalnica, hodnik in stopnišče, zajeti s Scaniverse na telefonu brez LiDAR-ja; izvoz OBJ, uvoz v Rhino in Blender deluje.

Kaj ni delovalo: pri zajemu vseh treh prostorov hkrati tretji manjka; zahtevni predmeti (brisače, sanitarna oprema, steklenice) so slabi; aplikacija občasno izgubi orientacijo in zajem je treba ponoviti.
Dobro: vmesnik sproti kaže nezajete dele.
summary_en: Bathroom, hallway and stair captured with Scaniverse on a phone without LiDAR; OBJ export, import into Rhino and Blender works.

What did not work: capturing all three rooms at once misses the third; complex objects (towels, sanitary fittings, bottles) are poor; the app sometimes loses orientation and the capture has to be repeated.
Good: the interface shows unscanned areas while capturing.

exercises.title_sl: Metode s fotografijami in videom
exercises.title_en: Photo and video methods
summary_sl: RealityScan: najboljša kakovost mreže in teksture, a ena stran prostora vedno manjka.
KIRI Engine: samo način za predmete, omogoča merjenje in spremembo merila.
3D Live Scanner (odprtokoden): najboljši vmesnik za zajem, samodejno skrije stene. Sketchfab za ogled.
summary_en: RealityScan: best mesh and texture quality, but one side of the room is always missing.
KIRI Engine: object mode only, allows measuring and rescaling.
3D Live Scanner (open source): best capture interface, hides walls automatically. Sketchfab for viewing.

exercises.title_sl: Hodnik z zunanjim stopniščem: rekonstrukcija iz videa
exercises.title_en: Hallway with an outdoor stair: reconstruction from video
summary_sl: Dva videa 4K, 30 fps (počasi ob stenah 2:01, hitreje po sredini 1:14) in več kot 115 fotografij.
Poskusi: CUT3R (namestitev ni uspela), VGGT-Omega (GLB, rezultat neprepoznaven), COLMAP (približno 2 h, kaotično), uvoznik v Blenderju (ne deluje), Autodesk ReCap (napaka strežnika).
summary_en: Two 4K 30 fps videos (slow along the walls 2:01, faster through the middle 1:14) and over 115 photos.
Attempts: CUT3R (installation failed), VGGT-Omega (GLB, unrecognisable result), COLMAP (about 2 h, chaotic), Blender importer (not working), Autodesk ReCap (server error).

exercises.title_sl: Klet UL FA iz skupnih podatkov: CloudCompare in Rhino
exercises.title_en: UL FA basement from shared data: CloudCompare and Rhino
summary_sl: Podatki: Gretin PLY zajem kleti UL FA. Tri kontrolne mere (vrata 198 cm, stopnica 14 cm, polica 109 cm) so pokazale, da je treba oblak pomanjšati na približno 77 %.
CloudCompare: vzorčenje na 2 cm in filter SOR (4.475.975 na 220.187 točk), ročno čiščenje na 196.373 točk, rezi zgornje in spodnje etaže; rasterizacija in RANSAC nista dala uporabnih ploskev.
Tloris spodnje etaže je ročno izrisan s Trace Polyline; v Rhinu dve različici 3D modela (ShrinkWrap in MeshFromPoints).
summary_en: Data: Greta's PLY capture of the UL FA basement. Three check dimensions (door 198 cm, step 14 cm, shelf 109 cm) showed that the cloud had to be scaled to about 77 %.
CloudCompare: 2 cm subsampling and an SOR filter (4,475,975 to 220,187 points), manual cleaning to 196,373 points, slices of the upper and lower floor; rasterisation and RANSAC gave no usable planes.
The lower floor plan was traced by hand with Trace Polyline; two versions of the 3D model in Rhino (ShrinkWrap and MeshFromPoints).

exercises.title_en: Own location: two underpasses below Slovenska cesta by Kongresni trg
summary_sl: Dva sosednja prostora pod Slovensko cesto na severni strani Kongresnega trga. Veliki podhod: smer sever–jug, širok približno 5 m in dolg 30 do 40 m, vhoda s stopnicami in rampo, ob obeh straneh valovite steklene vitrine namesto sten. Mali podhod: približno 4 × 5 m, stopnice s trga, parkirni avtomati in steklena vrata v podzemno garažo.

LiDAR zajeme je z iPhone 18 Pro posnel nosilec predmeta, Robert je posnel po dva videa za vsak prostor (ob stenah in naravnost, 60 do 110 s) in izmeril mere: veliki podhod stopnica 14 cm, širina stopnišča 170 cm, višina 220 cm; mali podhod stopnica 14 cm, ograja 95 cm, širina hodnika k WC 142 cm.
Skice tlorisov obeh prostorov. Videi niso objavljeni, ker so v njih mimoidoči.
summary_en: Two adjacent spaces below Slovenska cesta on the north side of Kongresni trg. Large underpass: north to south, about 5 m wide and 30 to 40 m long, entrances with stairs and a ramp, wavy glass display cases on both sides instead of walls. Small underpass: about 4 × 5 m, stairs from the square, parking machines and a glass door to the underground garage.

The LiDAR captures were taken by the course holder with an iPhone 18 Pro; Robert recorded two videos per space (along the walls and straight through, 60 to 110 s) and measured: large underpass step 14 cm, stair width 170 cm, height 220 cm; small underpass step 14 cm, handrail 95 cm, corridor to the WC 142 cm.
Plan sketches of both spaces. The videos are not published because passers-by appear in them.

exercises.title_sl: Stopnišče: primerjava štirih aplikacij
exercises.title_en: Stairwell: four apps compared
summary_sl: Stopnišče stanovanjske stavbe od kleti proti vhodu: Scaniverse 6 min, Polycam 5 min, KIRI Engine 7 min, RealityScan 7 min.
Najboljši in najhitrejši Polycam.

Kaj ni delovalo: Scaniverse zgreši skoraj polovico prostora brez opozorila (ponovitev ne pomaga); pri Polycam ni sprotnega predogleda in brezplačni izvoz ne uspe; KIRI Engine obdelave ne izvede; RealityScan model zgradi iz ene same slike.
summary_en: Stairwell of a residential building from the basement towards the entrance: Scaniverse 6 min, Polycam 5 min, KIRI Engine 7 min, RealityScan 7 min.
Polycam was best and fastest.

What did not work: Scaniverse misses almost half the space without a warning (a repeat does not help); Polycam has no live preview and the free export fails; KIRI Engine does not process; RealityScan builds the model from a single image.

summary_sl: Hodnik in prehod v klet UL FA, dva posnetka (približno 29 s in 56 s, 60 fps); en v smeri hoje, drug proti stenam.
FFmpeg 3 sličice na sekundo, 256 slik, COLMAP (srednja kakovost, na procesorju, ker se je obdelava na grafični kartici sesula).
Rezultat: dva ločena redka oblaka (66.168 in 22.405 točk), izvoz PLY in LAS.
Kaj ni delovalo: oblaka nista zanesljivo poravnana, zadnji del drugega posnetka manjka, ni ploskev, merilo ni določeno z izmerjeno razdaljo.
summary_en: Corridor and passage to the UL FA basement, two videos (about 29 s and 56 s, 60 fps); one facing the walking direction, one facing the walls.
FFmpeg at 3 frames per second, 256 images, COLMAP (medium quality, on the CPU because GPU processing crashed).
Result: two separate sparse clouds (66,168 and 22,405 points), exported as PLY and LAS.
What did not work: the clouds are not reliably aligned, the end of the second video is missing, there are no surfaces, the scale is not set from a measured distance.

summary_en: Data: capture by Student 02 (Scaniverse, 778,087 points).
CloudCompare: 11.00 m crop, 1.5 cm subsampling, SOR filter, 151,854 points; local coordinates (X along the corridor after a 2.7° rotation).
Slice at +1.10 m (15 cm band) and section at x = 3.60 m; model of 14 closed solids (rhino3dm), watertight mesh, plan and sections (PDF).
Cloud-to-model check: median 1.52 cm, 90.8 % of points within 5 cm. No tape measurements attached.
Limits: a shelf hides part of the south wall, closed doors are generalised into the wall plane.

exercises.title_sl: Zajem sobe s Scaniverse
exercises.title_en: Room capture with Scaniverse
summary_sl: Dva zajema sobe s Scaniverse, 20. 10. 2026: način Area z 8K teksturo (mreža s 178.000 oglišči in 278.000 trikotniki, 120,8 MB) in Gaussian splat (329.000 Gaussovih točk, 78,1 MB).
Mreža pokaže razporeditev sobe in opreme, ob robovih ostanejo luknje; splat ohrani videz mize in predmetov, robovi in ospredje so zamegljeni.
Trajanje zajema in obdelave ni zapisano. Predogled je 5,9 s dolg vrtljiv video.
summary_en: Two room captures with Scaniverse on 20 Oct 2026: Area mode with an 8K texture (mesh with 178,000 vertices and 278,000 triangles, 120.8 MB) and a Gaussian splat (329,000 Gaussians, 78.1 MB).
The mesh shows the layout of the room and furniture with holes along the edges; the splat keeps the look of the desk and objects, the edges and foreground are blurred.
Capture and processing times were not recorded. The preview is a 5.9 s rotating video.

exercises.title_en: From the UL FA entrance to the basement: Scaniverse and Meshroom
summary_sl: Dva zajema s Scaniverse (način Mesh, po približno 5 min) in navaden video.
Scaniverse da berljiv pregled poti (luknje in popačeni robovi ostanejo).

Meshroom: 303 sličice, registriranih 84 (27,7 %), 62.612 točk, mreža s 111.896 trikotniki za omejen del opečne stene; napaka CUDA odpravljena z drugim gonilnikom, črna tekstura z izklopom korekcije osvetlitve.
Kaj ni delovalo: COLMAP se je večkrat zaprl, cela pot ni rekonstruirana, meritve s trakom še niso opravljene.
summary_en: Two Scaniverse captures (Mesh mode, about 5 min each) and an ordinary video.
Scaniverse gives a legible overview of the route (holes and distorted edges remain).

Meshroom: 303 frames, 84 registered (27.7 %), 62,612 points, a 111,896-triangle mesh of a limited patch of brick wall; a CUDA error fixed with another driver, a black texture fixed by turning off exposure correction.
What did not work: COLMAP closed repeatedly, the full route is not reconstructed, tape measurements not taken yet.

exercises.title_sl: Klet UL FA: od oblaka točk do modela v Rhinu
exercises.title_en: UL FA basement: from point cloud to a Rhino model
summary_sl: Izhodišče je LiDAR zajem kleti s Scaniverse z dne 2. 11. 2026 (isti zajem kot pri Greti Kočar), pregledan in očiščen v CloudCompare (rezi, merjenje med dvema točkama).
V Rhinu je obris hodnika v obliki črke L izvlečen v zaprto telo, visoko 3,00 m (višina je predpostavka); tloris 1:100 (PDF, DXF).
Kontrola oblak : model: dolg rob glavnega hodnika 20,82 m : 23,10 m (+2,28 m), širina na levem koncu 2,07 m : 2,81 m (+0,74 m), notranji rob krila 7,25 m : 6,62 m (−0,63 m).
Kaj ni delovalo: končnih točk iz oblaka ni bilo mogoče zanesljivo povezati z modelom, zato so razlike le približne; model ne vsebuje stopnic, obokov in sosednjih prostorov.
summary_en: The source is the Scaniverse LiDAR capture of the basement from 2 Nov 2026 (the same capture as Greta Kočar's), inspected and cleaned in CloudCompare (slices, two-point measuring).
In Rhino the L-shaped corridor outline is extruded into a closed solid 3.00 m high (the height is an assumption); plan 1:100 (PDF, DXF).
Cloud to model check: long edge of the main corridor 20.82 m : 23.10 m (+2.28 m), width at the left end 2.07 m : 2.81 m (+0.74 m), inner edge of the wing 7.25 m : 6.62 m (−0.63 m).
What did not work: the end points in the cloud could not be matched reliably to the model, so the differences are only approximate; the model leaves out the stairs, vaults and adjoining rooms.
